content: Role parameter with array base type Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00072, SRS_Rte_00029 The type for a role parameter shall be the array base type of the Implementation- DataType of the RunnableEntityArgument if • the RunnableEntityArgument references an ImplementationDataType AND, • the ImplementationDataType of the RunnableEntityArgument resolves to an Array Implementation Data Type AND • the serverArgumentImplPolicy of the RunnableEntityArgument is not defined AND • no mapping to a BswModuleEntry is defined for the RunnableEntity .
